title: Enforce tenant-scoped KMS rotation policy and add immutable audit-proxy for rotation proofs
author: Riya Patel
description: Motivation: Several regulators and large customers require demonstrable tenant-scoped key rotation and server-side proof that data keys were rewrapped with the tenant's active CMK. This PR adds enforcement hooks to the KMS layer to ensure tenant key rotation policies are honored and introduces an immutable audit-proxy that signs and stores rotation proof envelopes to a write-once audit bucket. Summary of changes: 1) KMS: new "rotation_enforcer" middleware that validates rotation requests, enforces tenant CMK scoping, and rejects cross-region or public-key rotations when tenant policy forbids them; 2) Rewrap flow: server-side atomic rewrap operation with fallback to region-affine CMK when primary CMK is unavailable, with detailed failure reasons surfaced to callers; 3) Audit proxy: new stateless service (audit-proxy) that accepts signed rotation envelopes, appends a signature and monotonic sequence number, and forwards to immutable storage (S3 WORM + signed manifests); 4) RBAC v2 policy: new permission "kms:force-rotate" and mapping changes so only authorized platform service accounts and tenant admins (with explicit grant) can trigger forced rotations; 5) Migration: a safe migration script that detects keys out of compliance and schedules background rewrap jobs under a controlled feature-flag rollout; 6) Tests and docs: end-to-end tests for rotation and audit proofs, updated compliance docs and runbook. Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag "rbac_v2_key_rotation_enforcer"; start canary on internal/test tenants, monitor rotation latency and audit-proxy throughput for 48h, then expand to steady-state. Backout: feature-flag off returns system to previous behavior; we also include an emergency admin endpoint to abort in-flight rewrap batches. Checklist: [x] KMS middleware implemented and unit tested [x] Rewrap atomic operation implemented and e2e-tested in perf-canary harness [x] Audit proxy implemented with signature and monotonic sequencing [x] RBAC policy schema changes and mapping test vectors included [x] Migration script with dry-run mode [x] Runbook and release notes drafted [x] Security review completed. Impact: introduces new small latency on forced-rotation calls (projected +50ms median) and audit-proxy adds write bandwidth; no plaintext key material leaves the KMS. Notes: we opted for signed rotation envelopes (PKI) rather than storing raw CMK identifiers in the audit log to reduce exposure and to allow later re-validation; rotation failures are retried with exponential backoff and recorded in the audit proxy. Related: ENG-5124 (key-management roadmap), SEC-210 (audit-chain requirements).

feat(audit-proxy): initial implementation of signed-envelope append-only proxy
feat(kms): atomic rewrap operation with region-affine fallback
chore(rbac): add kms:force-rotate permission and mapping tests
test(kms): integration tests for rotation and audit flow
docs(compliance): runbook and release notes for rotation enforcement
review_comments: Ethan Huang: Can you clarify the failure semantics when the tenant CMK is temporarily unavailable? Please document the retry/backoff and the observable error codes.

Riya Patel: Reply: rotation_enforcer surfaces canonical error codes: KMS_UNAVAILABLE, POLICY_VIOLATION, REWRAP_FAILED. Retry is exponential up to 5 attempts with Jitter. I added details to the runbook and integration tests that assert retry semantics.
Marta Lopez: Request changes: Audit-proxy should include a monotonic sequence id to prevent reorder attacks; also ensure manifests are signed with platform key.
Riya Patel: Reply: added monotonic seq and manifest signing; included safety checks in proxy and unit tests for manifest verification.
Owen Park: Approved: security review looks good, small nits around logging level for rotation failures; prefer WARN not ERROR for transient network errors.
Riya Patel: Fixed: adjusted logging and added a metrics counter for transient failures.
CI: Integration tests flaked on first run (timeout in e2e), re-ran pipeline, all checks green.
release_notes: Enforce tenant-scoped KMS rotation policies by introducing a rotation enforcement middleware, atomic rewrap flow with region-affine fallback, and an immutable signed audit-proxy to record rotation proofs. RBAC adds kms:force-rotate for authorized principals. Rollout via feature-flag. See docs/compliance/key-rotation-runbook.md for migration steps and monitoring guidance.
